notes.title: SURVIVE: THE A.I. Beta Playtest Begins!
notes.content:
[quote][p][b]What if your cards could talk?[/b]
Welcome to [i]SURVIVETHE.AI[/i], the first card game where your cards talk, think, and advise you in battle.[/p][/quote][p]🌍 [b]Set in 2053[/b], choose between Humans, AI, or Hybrids and battle over Energy, Compute, and Creativity.
⚔️ Play fast-paced tactical card matches on a zone-based battlefield inspired by Marvel Snap.
🧠 Your cards [b]speak strategy in real time[/b], helping you outsmart foes and unlock powerful Awaken skills.
🧬 Build deep connections with your agents and explore the future of interactive AI gameplay.[/p]
